bash -lc 'python - << "PY"
import io,sys
p="/src/libxml2/HTMLparser.c"
text=open(p).read()
old="buffer = (xmlChar *) xmlMallocAtomic(buffer_size);"
new="buffer = (xmlChar *) xmlMallocAtomic(buffer_size + 1);"
if old in text:
    text=text.replace(old,new)
else:
    print("Patch pattern not found",file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
open(p,"w").write(text)
print("Patched HTMLparser.c")
PY'
